title: Blueprint
description: Canonical structure for a Forge project blueprint. This document is the single source of truth for what a blueprint is; no other validator may redefine these rules. Schema version: 1.0.0.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the document was authored against. Used by the loader to pick a compatible validator.

id.description: Stable, dotted identifier used to reference the blueprint from the CLI (e.g. python.fastapi.api).

name.description: Human-readable blueprint name shown in the interactive selector.

version.description: Semantic version of the blueprint itself (independent of the schema).

description.description: One-paragraph explanation of what the blueprint generates.

category.title: Category
category.description: Coarse classifier used for grouping in the selector.

maintainer.description: Optional contact (handle or email) for the blueprint owner.

variables.description: Ordered list of variables the blueprint exposes to the user. Order is preserved by the wizard. Optional; the model defaults it to an empty list, which is what 'a blueprint with no configurable options' means. Do not add this to `required`: `required` and `default` are mutually exclusive in JSON Schema — if a field is required, the default is never applied, and the two together are a contradiction.

files.description: Static template-to-destination mappings applied unconditionally. Optional; the model defaults it to an empty list. Same `required`/`default` caveat as `variables`.

conditional_files.description: Additional file mappings applied only when a condition expression evaluates true. Optional; the model defaults it to an empty list.

verification.description: Contract the generated project must satisfy after scaffolding. Required, and non-empty: a blueprint that declares no verification cannot be trusted to produce a working project.

compatibility.title: Compatibility
compatibility.description: Minimum Forge CLI version required to consume this blueprint.

variable.title: VariableDefinition
variable.description: A single blueprint variable. Declared as an ordered list entry so the wizard presents prompts in the author's intended order. The 'type' field is the discriminator: 'enum' requires a validation.enum list, 'boolean' forbids a validation block, and 'string' may use validation.pattern.

id.description: Variable identifier, referenced in templates and conditional expressions.

description.description: Explanation shown to the user while prompting.

required.description: Whether the wizard must collect a value. Defaults to true at the schema level.

default.description: Optional default value. Its runtime type must match the declared variable type; that constraint is enforced semantically by the verification layer.

variableType.title: VariableType
variableType.description: Value type. 'enum' requires a validation.enum list; 'string' may optionally use validation.pattern; 'boolean' takes no validation.

pattern.description: RE2-compatible regular expression the string value must match in full. Only meaningful when type is 'string'.

enum.description: Allowed values. Required when type is 'enum'.

fileMapping.title: FileEntry
fileMapping.description: A template-to-destination mapping. Applied unconditionally from the top-level 'files' array, or conditionally from within a 'conditionalFiles' entry. Both paths must be relative and must not escape the blueprint or project root.

source.description: Path to the template file, relative to the blueprint root. Must stay within the blueprint directory (path traversal is rejected at load time).

destination.description: Path in the generated project; may include {{variable}} interpolation. Must be relative.

conditionalFiles.title: ConditionalFileEntry
conditionalFiles.description: A group of file mappings applied only when the 'condition' expression evaluates true at generation time. The condition is a simple boolean expression over variable ids (e.g. 'include_docker == true'); it is intentionally not a full expression language.

condition.description: Simple boolean expression over variable ids, e.g. 'include_docker == true'.

verificationCheck.title: CheckDefinition
verificationCheck.description: A single check the generated project must satisfy. The 'type' field is the discriminator: 'command' runs a shell command and requires the 'command' field; 'required_file' asserts a path exists and requires the 'path' field. Every blueprint must declare at least one check.

id.description: Stable identifier for the check, used in reports.

command.description: Shell command to run. Required when type == 'command'.

path.description: Path to assert existence, relative to the project root. Required when type == 'required_file'.

timeout.description: Seconds before a command check is considered failed.

checkType.title: CheckType
checkType.description: Kind of check. 'command' runs a shell command; 'required_file' asserts a path exists.
